app.title: AgriTwin Rwanda
app.tagline: Umusaruro nyawo ugereranyije n'umusaruro ushobora kugerwaho wagenwe na moderi, ku karere.
app.modelBadge: Igereranyo rishingiye kuri moderi, si imibare y'ubutegetsi
app.footer: AgriTwin Rwanda. NISR 2026 Big Data Hackathon. Si imibare y'ubutegetsi ya NISR.

map.legendTitle: Icyuho cy'umusaruro: nyawo ugereranyije n'ushobora kugerwaho
map.legendSuppressed: Ubunyu: amasambu make yakorewe ubushakashatsi kugira ngo ibisubizo byizerwe
map.reliabilityNote: Kwizerwa: {{reliability}}. Amasambu make yakorewe ubushakashatsi kugira ngo igereranyo riboneke neza.
map.noData: Nta makuru ya {{crop}} mu gihembwe {{season}} {{year}} muri aka karere.

district.yieldTrendCaption: Umusaruro nyawo w'akarere wa {{crop}}, igihembwe {{season}}, ku myaka.
district.yieldTrendEmpty: Nta myaka ifite amakuru agaragara kuri iki gihingwa n'iki gihembwe.
district.gapTrendCaption: Umusaruro nyawo ugereranyije n'umusaruro ushobora kugerwaho wagenwe na moderi: uburyo aka karere gashobora kwiyongera.
district.gapTrendEmpty: Nta myaka ifite icyuho cyabazwe kuri iki gihingwa n'iki gihembwe.
district.driversCaption: Isano ivuye muri moderi ya SHAP, si ingaruka zisobanutse (itegeko ry'umushinga: "bifitanye isano na", ntabwo ari "bitera" cyangwa "byongera umusaruro na").
district.driversEmpty: Nta makuru ahagije yo gushyiraho urutonde rw'ibitera muri aka karere.
district.nowcastCaption: Igereranyo ryapimwe hasigaye umwaka umwe, {{lead}} amezi mu gihembwe, ntabwo ari igiteganyo cyo mu gihe nyacyo: buri gice cyerekanwa uyu munsi ni amakuru y'abanje kugenzurwa.
district.nowcastEmpty: Nta gereranyo rya mbere kuri {{crop}} mu gihembwe {{season}} {{year}} kuri iki gihe.
district.modelUsedNote: Moderi yakoreshejwe: {{model}}, yatoranyijwe kuko yari ifite ikosa rito kuri iki gihingwa n'iki gihe — akenshi ni impuzandengo y'akarere, ntabwo ari moderi igoye. Reba urupapuro rw'uburyo bwakoreshejwe kugira ngo ubone igereranya ryuzuye.
district.scenarioCaption: Igereranyo rishingiye kuri moderi ry'umusaruro impuzandengo mu gihe hifashishijwe ingamba runaka, si igerageza ry'ikintu nyacyo.
district.scenarioEmpty: Nta makuru y'ibishoboka kuri aka karere n'iki gihingwa.
district.peersCaption: Uturere duri mu karere kamwe ka moderi (gakozwe ukoresheje k-means, kubera ko nta rutonde nyarwo rw'uturere tw'ubuhinzi ruhari muri uyu mushinga).
district.briefCaption: Inyandiko ya PDF y'urupapuro rumwe irimo ibihingwa 4 by'ingenzi muri aka karere, yateguwe mbere y'igihe.
